## Changes made from the upstream version

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-06:

- Rewrote the skill in SkillOffice format; body reduced from about 340 lines to about 90.
- Kept the diagnosis (A/B/C), decompose-and-lock, three-question gate, supportable-claims rule and leave-it-alone test.
- Moved style rules, the AI-pattern list, headline shapes and CTA formula into `references/writing-rules.md` (shared with mkt-copy-editing).
- Removed third-party brand examples, book statistics, references to the upstream product-marketing context file and to upstream skills not imported.
- Added SkillOffice context fields, output language and currency handling, safety and handoff sections.

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-17 (version 0.2.0):

- Added an "Ask first" section (original SkillOffice content).
